channel.title: Make incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Make's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Delayed scenario executions on us2.make.com [resolved]
item.description: Between 16:00–16:45 CEST, US2 Zone (us2.make.com) experienced delays in scenario executions due to high resource utilization. The root cause has been identified and the situation is now stable. All affected scenarios from this timeframe have been reactivated.

item.title: Delay in scenario executions affecting the EU1 (eu1.make.com) [resolved]
item.description: There was an issue causing delays with scenario executions on the EU1 (eu1.make.com) region between 10:45 and 11:05 CEST. The issue has been resolved, and the service is now fully operational and working normally. Thank you for your patience, and we apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused.

item.title: Issues with Scenario saving and Execution on EU2 [resolved]
item.description: The issue affecting the EU2 (eu2.make.com) region has been fully resolved, and all system operations have returned to normal.

item.title: Scenarios disabled [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved.

item.title: Limited availability of the Anthropic & OpenAI models on eu1.make.com and us2.make.com [resolved]
item.description: Claude Fable 5, the Claude Opus model family, and the OpenAI GPT (pro & sol) models are available again in Make AI Provider, Make AI Toolkit and the Anthropic Claude - Simple Text Prompt module. All models are now fully operational. Thank you for your patience.

item.title: Scenario executions delayed in eu1.make.celonis.com [resolved]
item.description: Unexpected database load from another Make component caused a CPU spike that delayed scenario executions in eu1.make.celonis.com. This has been addressed and the zone is operating normally.

item.title: Scenarios execution degraded [resolved]
item.description: We’re reaching out to let you know that the issue affecting scenario execution has been resolved, and most of the previously disabled scenarios have been re-enabled. Remaining affected scenarios will be handled individually. System execution has stabilized and normal operations have resumed.

item.title: EU1 - Scenarios failing at initialization with "Failed to verify account" error [resolved]
item.description: Between 17:29 and 17:34 CEST on 22nd of July, scenarios on the EU1 zone failed at initialization with a "Failed to verify account" error, affecting connections across all apps. Approximately 200 scenarios were automatically deactivated as a result and have since been re-enabled. We are actively working to prevent recurrence.

item.title: US2 - New connection & connection re-authorization resulting in error (SC424) [resolved]
item.description: The issue has been resolved at 10:00 CEST.

item.title: Increased scenario failures — Cloudflare API incident [resolved]
item.description:
Between 15:30 and 17:27 CEST, some users might experienced an increased number of failed or invalid scenarios on zones EU1, EU2, US1, US2.
This was caused by an incident on Cloudflare's side, where their API returned 500 errors affecting request routing through our infrastructure. The issue was fully resolved by 17:27 CEST once Cloudflare restored normal API operation.
We apologise for the inconvenience.

item.title: Login Instability [resolved]
item.description: Between 14:05 and 14:35 CEST (12:05 – 12:35 UTC), we experienced an issue that caused intermittent login instability across our platform. Our engineering team identified the root cause and applied a fix, restoring full access.

item.title: Facebook Lead Ads Error: "Unsupported get request. Object with ID "..." does not exist, cannot be loaded due to missing permissions or does not support this operation" [resolved]
item.description:
Meta has resolved the issue on their end, and API traffic has returned to normal state. Your Facebook Lead Ads scenarios should now be working as expected, and new leads from Facebook will resume flowing through without issues.
If you are still experiencing issues, do not hesitate to contact our support.
